source.title: [FINAL] 2020 Annual Report
source.provider: Department of Agriculture - National Fisheries Research and Development Institute (DA-NFRDI)
source.program: Fisheries Resources and Ecological Assessment of Manila Bay Component I: Fish Resources Assessment of Manila Bay (Ongoing)
source.accessStatus: Official DA-NFRDI PDF; report text and project summary reviewed from the official indexed document.
source.reuseStatus: No item-specific reuse license was verified. Keep this as an attributed research summary and do not reproduce report content or publish derived app content pending rights review.

reportedEvidence.siteNamedInReport: Rosario Fish Port, Cavite is named as one of the landing sites where enumerators worked; the report does not allocate the leading taxon or its 19% share to Rosario.
reportedEvidence.temporalCoverageLimit: Report states that data collection was temporarily stopped from March through June 2020 due to COVID-19 and weather disruptions.
reportedEvidence.basis: The report summarizes landed catch across eight Manila Bay fish landing sites. It is a fishery-level, aggregate catch statement, not a specimen-level occurrence or capture-site record.

decision.use: Retain the named taxon and reported share as dated, aggregate Manila Bay fishery context and a lead for site-resolved follow-up.

limitations: A landed catch can include fish caught outside the named landing site's immediate waters; landing location is not capture location.
The 19% figure is source-reported at the aggregate Manila Bay assessment level; its precise denominator and per-site breakdown are not provided in the reviewed summary.
The report's 225 reported species types are not enumerated in this annual-report passage and cannot be treated as a complete checklist.
The 2020 sampling interruption means the annual summary has uneven temporal coverage.
Do not infer present-day occurrence, abundance, catchability, seasonality, legal status, safety, diet, bait advice, or precise capture coordinates.
nextStep: Seek the underlying eight-site 2020 port-sampling tables, exact site-level dates and source reuse terms from NFRDI; keep aggregate Manila Bay catch evidence separate from waterbody occurrence records and Cavite-only claims.
